message: Interpreter prioritization after Operator asked about progress toward useful automation and asked to continue: separate minimum useful unattended Jarvis rollout from complete Automation 1.0. Determine exact current deployed vs main capability and smallest remaining blockers for supervised Jarvis-only automatic dispatch/health/challenge wake under existing project switch, STOP and no-replay. Three-state production simplification explicitly follow-up (parent v2 says rollout gate unchanged), broad pertinence/robustness audit and managed provider work must not become new blockers without concrete dependency. Identify exact existing approved rollout scope, current schedule/config, minimal targeted acceptance and safe rollback; give actionable plan, no premature live activation/deploy. Continue W3/W8/W17/W14 serial leases and independent work; distinguish genuine safety prerequisites from full release gates.
